nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $T$ be a bounded linear operator on $E$, let $(\lambda_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be pairwise distinct scalars in $\mathbb{K}$, and let $(u_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be nonzero vectors in $E$ with $T u_n = \lambda_n u_n$ for every $n$. Then for every $n$, the vector $u_n$ does not lie in the linear span of $\{u_i : i < n\}$.
nodes.title: Eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues are not in the span of earlier ones

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $(u_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be vectors in $E$, and for each $n$ let $V_n$ be the linear span of $\{u_i : i < n\}$. Suppose $u_n \notin V_n$ for every $n$. Then for every $n$ there is a vector $y \in V_{n+1}$ with $\|y\| = 1$ and $\|y - z\| \ge 1/2$ for every $z \in V_n$.
nodes.title: Riesz separation for nested spans

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $T$ be a compact bounded linear operator on $E$, and let $\varepsilon > 0$ be real. Then the set of eigenvalues $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$ of $T$ with $|\mu| \ge \varepsilon$ is finite.
nodes.title: Finiteness of eigenvalues of a compact operator bounded away from zero

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $T$ be a bounded linear operator on $E$, and let $(\lambda_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ in $\mathbb{K}$ and $(u_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ in $E$ satisfy $T u_n = \lambda_n u_n$ for every $n$. Then for every $n$ and every $y$ in the linear span of $\{u_i : i \le n\}$, the vector $T y$ also lies in that span.
nodes.title: Invariance of spans of eigenvectors

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be an infinite-dimensional Banach space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$ and let $T$ be a compact bounded linear operator on $E$. Then $T$ is not bijective.
nodes.title: A compact operator on an infinite-dimensional Banach space is not bijective

nodes.summary: If `T` is compact and `E` is infinite-dimensional, then `T` has no two-sided inverse among bounded operators. (Completeness of `E` is not needed for this statement.)
nodes.title: A compact operator on an infinite-dimensional space is not a unit

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $T$ be a bounded linear operator on $E$, let $(\lambda_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ in $\mathbb{K}$ and $(u_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ in $E$ satisfy $T u_n = \lambda_n u_n$ for every $n$, and for each $n$ let $V_n$ be the linear span of $\{u_i : i < n\}$. Then for every $n$ and every $y \in V_{n+1}$, we have $T y - \lambda_n y \in V_n$.
nodes.title: An operator acts as a scalar on a span of eigenvectors modulo a smaller span

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$ and let $T$ be a compact bounded linear operator on $E$. If $(\lambda_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ is a sequence of pairwise distinct eigenvalues of $T$, then $\lambda_n \to 0$ as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Eigenvalues of a compact operator tend to zero along any injective sequence

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be an infinite-dimensional normed space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$ and let $T$ be a compact bounded linear operator on $E$. Then $0$ lies in the spectrum of $T$ in the algebra of bounded linear operators on $E$; that is, $T$ has no bounded two-sided inverse.
nodes.title: Zero lies in the spectrum of a compact operator on an infinite-dimensional space

can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
